comment: Secondary data source spreadsheet IDs, keyed by fiscal year. Two source types are distinguished: 'state_head_dashboard' (aggregated plan/ordered/received per person per month, used for FY2025-26 and FY2026-27) and 'register' (line-level secondary order rows, FY2021-22 through FY2024-25). Add the real sheet IDs for FY2021-22 through FY2024-25 once those workbooks are available. Entries with sheet_id set to null are skipped by the loader. IMPORTANT: these are SECONDARY (distributor->retailer) figures and must never be summed with primary sale_line data.

2024-25.comment: Provide the FY2024-25 secondary register sheet ID to enable this FY. grain=line: individual customer-level rows.

2023-24.comment: FY2023-24 secondary register uses sub-total grain: rows are head/month/brand aggregates, not individual customer lines. The loader will detect and exclude any intermediate sub-total marker rows (rows whose first five cells match sub_total_skip_tokens) before parsing. Provide the sheet ID to enable. uid key: fy|monthLabel|headRaw|stateRaw|(null customer)|brandRaw|amount|occurrence.

2022-23.comment: Provide the FY2022-23 secondary register sheet ID to enable this FY.

2021-22.comment: Provide the FY2021-22 secondary register sheet ID to enable this FY.
